brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In “The Choice at the Bridge,” Mira walks onto a narrow bridge to help a boy. Find a crossing like hers, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line and tap which text it comes from. Then finish two sentences about courage.
extra: Take one step forward, like Mira. Say one brave thing a kid your age could do.
step1: You won’t build today. You will find a crossing like Mira’s. Read the three things to look for. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Walk and teleport through the town. Find a narrow place to cross, with one side and another side. No bridge? A narrow street works.
step4: Stand at your crossing and say this out loud. Mira was brave because… Courage means…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
